thread:
anya: FYI deploying v2024.11 -> staged 10% across ap-south / eu-west. Quick smoke found higher tokenization failures on some long-system prompts in eu-west. Can we gate?

deploy-bot: deploy 1840000001 by anya 10pct canary targets: 6/60 ready. logs: `ingress->tokenizer` stream available.

devon: which tokenizer binary landed? new build includes token-v2. frank, did we include the safe-fallback flag?

frank: Build used token-v2. CI default flips fallback=false. I raised a packaging PR but it didn't merge into release artifact.

ops-runner: Recommend immediate bake-hold at 10%. Quick mitigation: flip `tokenizer.enable_fallback=true` via remote config for rollout=canary then observe 10m. If no improvement, rollback to v2024.10.

anya: Agreed. Can we do the config flip without a new deploy?

infra-bot: running: `rwctl config patch --env=prod --selector=rollout=canary --set tokenizer.enable_fallback=true`

infra-bot: patch applied to 6/6 targets. change-id=cfg-1840000001-a

ops-runner: Observing metrics now. Initial 5m window: parse_error_rate dropped from 1.2% -> 0.2% in eu-west. p99 latency improved ~90ms. Recommend hold for full 20m bake.

devon: I'll validate with 200 synthetic long prompts against canary IPs. posting short results in 5m.

frank: Updated release notes draft to include tokenizer behavior and fallback remediation steps. PR: `release-notes/v2024.11-tokenizer`

release-manager: Change window runs til 19:00 UTC. We need a quick vote to continue ramp after bake. :thumbsup: to proceed to 25% after successful bake, :thumbsdown: to keep hold or roll back.

anya: :thumbsup: after 20m bake

devon: :thumbsup: (synthetic tests look good so far)

frank: :thumbsup:

ops-runner: :thumbsup: (I'll keep dashboard alarms on)

release-manager: Consensus = ramp after bake. I'll pin a note on the rollout ticket and unpin emergency rollback. schedule: ramp to 25% at ~1840002300 (20m).

deploy-bot: annotate rollout 1840000001: "fallback enabled via config patch cfg-1840000001-a; bake hold"

anya: thanks all. If devon sees any regressions in the next 15m call it out and we revert to v2024.10.

infra-bot: scheduled action: ramp 25% at 1840002300 unless hold flag set.

devon: quick update: 200/200 synthetic long prompts passed tokenization and downstream parse. No crash traces.

anya: great. standing down for bake. will watch telemetry.

infra-bot: bake window timer started (20m).
